parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular at about 90 bpm. V1 has a tall R with T-wave inversion, V2–V3 show a wide rSR' (M-shaped) complex, and V5–V6 and lead I have small slurred S waves, which fits right bundle branch block rather than a normal ECG. There is no convincing ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria.
